summary: Tested Owner Dashboard aggregator (/api/companies/{cid}/owner-dashboard) + frontend tabs (Overview/Money/Documents/Team), client redirect, period switching, invoice expected-date save, dunning reminder, mobile responsiveness, and projections cashflow regression. Backend 7/7 pass. Frontend works end-to-end with ONE bug: client user with no company lands in an infinite 'Loading your business…' spinner on /owner instead of the required owner-dashboard-no-company empty state. Fixed one minor test blocker (Big component dropped data-testid).

ui_bugs.issue: When user has no company_id, load() short-circuits without setting loading=false and `data` stays null, so page shows the owner-dashboard-loading spinner forever. Required owner-dashboard-no-company empty state is never rendered. Repros as client@axiom.ai after login (company_id is null) hitting /dashboard (which does redirect to /owner correctly).

ONLY failing scenario: client@axiom.ai (no company) → /dashboard → /owner stays on owner-dashboard-loading forever; owner-dashboard-no-company never rendered. Fix in OwnerDashboard.jsx around the `if (!data)` return.
rca of the issue:
In /app/frontend/src/pages/OwnerDashboard.jsx the useCallback load() returns early with `if (!currentId) return;` while leaving loading=true and data=null. The render path only checks `if (!data)` and emits the owner-dashboard-loading spinner, so a user with no company (e.g. client@axiom.ai after the /dashboard → /owner redirect) is stuck on 'Loading your business…'. Mitigation: add `if (!currentId) return
You don't have a company yet.
;` before the existing !data check, OR flip loading=false inside the early return. Reproduction: login as client@axiom.ai/client123, visit /dashboard, observe URL redirects to /owner and content stays as spinner with owner-dashboard-loading testid.
